title: Most Active Fintech Investors in London 2026 — Top 15
text:
Most Active Fintech Investors in London 2026

15 firms writing Fintech checks in London, led by Goldman Sachs, Augmentum Fintech, Index Ventures — ranked by verified deal count with the companies behind.

Home › Research › Most Active Fintech Investors in London 2026

Fintech in London accounts for 31 tracked companies with verified cap-table data, 31 of which disclose round sizes totalling $12B. The median disclosed raise is $200M, and the largest is Revolut at $1.7B, ahead of Checkout.com ($1.7B) and Abound ($1.5B).

The names that recur most often on these fintech cap tables are LocalGlobe (3 companies), Passion Capital (3 companies), Insight Partners (2 companies), Citi (2 companies), World Innovation Lab (2 companies), Balderton Capital (2 companies). By latest disclosed round, the market skews Series B (10), Series C (6), Series A (5), Growth (4).
